creator: Alexander Terp
description: Run outside a pane with several windows open, both ask every window and print only 'a pane's text' or 'a list of daemons' per window (JSON 'unreadable'): crates/muster-cli/src/render.rs answers() renders only Window payloads, and muster_proto::only_reads includes both requests. The docs now tell a caller to pass --socket. A pane read names one pane, so it arguably belongs to the one window holding it.
title: muster pane read and muster daemons print a placeholder with several windows open
